name: serge
description: A web interface for chatting with Alpaca through llama.cpp. Fully dockerized, with an easy to use API.

issues.title: [Enhancement] Add the Ability to Use NVIDIA for Docker
🐛 [Bug]: system reachable via ICMP and via Port 8008 but screen "navy blue" with no text whatsoever
🐛 [Bug]: New install - response keeps repeating the last line
Add the possibility to upload PDFs in the front part of the application to read it
🐛 [Bug]: response text generated by a model sometimes disappears after computer/browser is woken up from a 'sleep'
🐛 [Bug]: Number with open parentheses does not show in the UI

latest_release.name: 0.9.0 - Updates to dependencies and UI fixes
